tasks.open_question: The old synthetic-self comparison and phantom-only slope window do not test the current carrier-plus-phantom construction against the real map.
tasks.first_calculation: Use L321's X-COP gas/mass inputs as a starting control, then solve the selected current cluster-carrier-plus-phantom gas/pressure profile. Freeze the aperture/slope prediction before fitting real map cutouts, with beam, mask, background and covariance controls.
tasks.completion_criterion: Report an actual residual/likelihood with nuisance sensitivity and a matched baseline, or a specific missing calibration that prevents a data score.
tasks.controls_and_limits: Verify map units and provenance before use; do not relabel synthetic validation as a data fit. L321's older kernel/EFE and retention prescription are controls, not the current construction. Supply the selected current cluster carrier profile without borrowing a chosen merger-core shape.
deliverables: Calculation source and verification commands when computational; explicit derivation and hypotheses when analytic.
tasks.default_execution_scope: One bounded calculation and its audit; no task claims a completed gravity theory.

tasks.title: Derive the physical-metric post-Newtonian parameters
external_prerequisites: If adopting a C01 variant, rerun/transfer-audit C02 on that exact action. Retrieve primary observational sources at execution time.
tasks.open_question: A reduced frozen preferred-frame calculation does not determine the full action's measured-G post-Newtonian response.
tasks.first_calculation: Derive the slow moving-source near-zone solution on a declared nonzero background, retaining the reciprocal source, projection and gate. Match the physical metric to measured G_N, beta, gamma and the preferred-frame parameters.
tasks.completion_criterion: Obtain the parameters on a controlled domain and compare with primary experimental likelihoods, or isolate the obstruction to the near-zone expansion.
tasks.controls_and_limits: Freeze CA5 or a named successful C01 variant and recheck transferred constraints. Recover the prior reduced limit only as a control; a failure in that family is not a universal no-go.
deliverables: Calculation source and verification commands when computational; explicit derivation and hypotheses when analytic.

tasks.title: Propagate tensor waves through an activated interface
external_prerequisites: Supply an admissible inhomogeneous background and control constraint mixing; a prescribed off-shell interface is only a diagnostic.
tasks.open_question: A homogeneous tensor-cone result does not control propagation through a spatially varying activated region.
tasks.first_calculation: Derive the constrained tensor and mixed principal operator on a smooth nonzero-gate background, retaining filter/metric variations. Propagate a small packet across the interface and track flux, mode conversion and physical arrival time.
tasks.completion_criterion: Bound the physical tensor speed, reflection/conversion and energy on the declared background class, or identify a concrete pathology.
tasks.controls_and_limits: Use the actual matter metric. Recover the homogeneous limit and distinguish a time delay from a change in front speed; criterion B still applies to non-tensor modes.
deliverables: Calculation source and verification commands when computational; explicit derivation and hypotheses when analytic.

tasks.title: Calculate nonlinear charge conversion with halo backreaction
external_prerequisites: C05/C07 provide prerequisites, not a nonlinear evolution theorem; verify the numerical problem and domain before expensive runs.
tasks.open_question: The linear pump bound and small packet conversion do not establish useful carrier evacuation from a self-gravitating halo.
tasks.first_calculation: Evolve a small controlled halo with the action's carrier conversion, pump depletion, self-gravity and auxiliary solve. Track charge and energy fluxes across a declared outer boundary and the retained radial mass.
tasks.completion_criterion: Measure achievable evacuation and its energy budget before backreaction shuts off conversion, with convergence and conserved-charge controls; compare only against a separately derived phenomenological requirement.
tasks.controls_and_limits: Do not inject a random kick or impose a desired cleared fraction. Use C16/C18 only to define a labeled target, never to claim their particle surrogate is the same action.
deliverables: Calculation source and verification commands when computational; explicit derivation and hypotheses when analytic.
tasks.default_execution_scope: One bounded calculation and its audit; no task claims a completed gravity theory.

tasks.title: Derive early-universe coldness and excitation transfer
external_prerequisites: Add the ordinary radiation/baryon sector consistently and verify the background solves the selected action over the tested interval.
tasks.open_question: A late homogeneous solution and healthy ultraviolet modes do not show that occupied carriers have the required early-universe transfer behavior.
tasks.first_calculation: On a declared radiation-to-matter background, derive rather than assume the rapid-oscillation averaged pressure, anisotropic stress and perturbation equations of the five real carrier fields, with ordinary radiation/baryons and auxiliaries included.
tasks.completion_criterion: Quantify the domain of cold behavior, isocurvature response and transfer-scale departures over a finite linear interval, or exhibit failure of the averaging hierarchy.
tasks.controls_and_limits: Check against unaveraged evolution on an overlap interval. Do not claim a CMB fit from background agreement or identify the classical fields with an extra particle population.
deliverables: Calculation source and verification commands when computational; explicit derivation and hypotheses when analytic.
tasks.default_execution_scope: One bounded calculation and its audit; no task claims a completed gravity theory.

tasks.title: Compute sourced radiation of the counted non-tensor modes
external_prerequisites: C02 and C35 must refer to the same frozen action, background domain and physical metric.
tasks.open_question: Counting modes and checking static preferred-frame parameters does not determine their radiative coupling to a binary.
tasks.first_calculation: Begin with a weakly self-gravitating binary within the near-zone domain from C35. Match its sourced constrained solution to outgoing preferred-time modes and derive leading energy flux, including dipole/quadrupole terms when present.
tasks.completion_criterion: Obtain a finite, consistently signed leading flux with an explicit regime of validity, or prove decoupling of the proposed radiative channel.
tasks.controls_and_limits: Separate instantaneous constraints from radiative degrees of freedom. Compact-star sensitivities and a pulsar-data constraint require further justified strong-field work; do not import them by analogy.
deliverables: Calculation source and verification commands when computational; explicit derivation and hypotheses when analytic.

tasks.title: Test the reciprocal barrier's radiative stability as an EFT
external_prerequisites: Explicitly adopt a quantum EFT extension; the classical construction alone does not require this calculation.
tasks.open_question: The classical reciprocal barrier has specially vanishing low derivatives; its preservation under a proposed quantization is a separate question.
tasks.first_calculation: Declare a Wilsonian quantization, cutoff and counterterm prescription. Compute the carrier determinant in an explicitly off-shell local constant-t background, then restore t=1+P_h Z and the full measure before varying. Extract induced local derivatives and the actual susceptibility of admissible mean-zero auxiliary perturbations about t=1.
tasks.completion_criterion: Identify protected relations or the counterterms/tuning required for the projected physical perturbations in the stated finite cutoff regime, with regulator, normalization and off-shell-extension dependence explicit.
tasks.controls_and_limits: A spatially constant physical t on a compact projected leaf is necessarily one; do not treat arbitrary constant t as an admissible cosmology. This is optional quantum EFT work. F(t)=F(1/t) alone is not a full kinetic-action symmetry, and no observed vacuum normalization or ultraviolet completion follows.
deliverables: Calculation source and verification commands when computational; explicit derivation and hypotheses when analytic.
tasks.default_execution_scope: One bounded calculation and its audit; no task claims a completed gravity theory.
